answer: Each identity registers one cedar thread lot at a tundra depot, locking an 80-credit bond. Its tag binds weight, depot, and key. Each epoch an auditor spot-checks lots: a checked thread lot must be at its tundra depot, weight and tag matching, or its bond burns. More lots mean more checks. Fees rise per wallet: first 34 credits, kth 34+7(k-1), 1000th 7027; 1000 fake lots cost 3,530,500 plus 80,000 locked. A lot-swapping ring fails: a swapped cedar thread lot misses its depot or weight, burning both bonds. An honest agent pays one fee and recovers its bond after a clean epoch.
